title: Wootz Steel
context: Prachyam · Gifts of India · Selected motion work
desc: Titles, maps and illustrated scenes for a documentary on Wootz steel.
lead: I created titles, maps and historical motion sequences for Prachyam’s Wootz Steel documentary.
body: Wootz Steel is a short documentary in Prachyam’s Gifts of India collection, exploring the history and craft of steelmaking. I led the creative direction and visual design of the selected motion work shown here.
detail: My work spans the title treatment, geographic sequences and illustrated historical environments, with composition, typography and motion treatment across these pieces.
contribution: Led creative direction and hands-on visual design for the selected sequences.
Developed composition, typography and motion treatments across titles, maps and historical scenes.
summary: I created titles, maps and historical motion sequences for Prachyam’s Wootz Steel documentary.
